newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Micro stock rallies after earnings report.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Micro stock rallies after earnings report.

text.p: The stock of computer component maker Advanced Micro Devices Inc. gained more than 11 percent Tuesday following better-than-expected fourth quarter results.

The Sunnyvale, Calif.-based maker of microprocessors and related peripheral equipment Monday reported a loss of 15 cents a share, or a net loss of $21.3 million. Analysts had predicted that Advanced Micro would lose 19 cents a share in the fourth quarter, according to First Call, which tracks corporate earnings estimates.
Advanced Micro stock was up $3.375 at $32.75 on the New York Stock Exchange in early afternoon trading.
In the fourth quarter, Advanced Micro had revenues of $496.9 million.
In the year earlier quarter, the company reported a profit of $9.3 million, or 7 cents a share, on revenues of $595.2 million.
